This violates the intended “same‑round confirm resolves same‑round challenge” semantics.

EXTEND C0003 | The REOPEN verdict is parsed but no handling exists in the provided code. There is no function to process REOPEN, and the status REOPENED is never set. This will cause REOPEN verdicts to be silently ignored, breaking the reopen workflow.

CHALLENGE C0005 — The condition `current_round - oldest > 1` is intentional: it gives a one‑round grace period for a challenge to be answered. A challenge in the current round (or the immediately previous round) is not counted as contested because the finding may still be defended. This is a design choice, not a bug.
